question: ‘Faster, More Inclusive and Sustainable Growth’ was the centre point of which Five-Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Twelfth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Twelfth Five-Year Plan of India was from **2012 to 2017**.
 
• The theme of the Twelfth Plan was "**Faster, More Inclusive and Sustainable Growth**".
 
• This plan aimed to achieve an annual average growth rate of **8%**.
 
• The Twelfth Plan focused on sectors such as infrastructure, energy, health, education, and social inclusion.
 
• The Planning Commission of India was responsible for formulating the Five-Year Plans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India**

 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan was launched in **1951** by the Planning Commission of India.
 
• The Planning Commission was replaced by the NITI Aayog in **2015**.
 
• The Five-Year Plans aimed at achieving planned economic development and growth in India.
 
 
 
• **Twelfth Plan Objectives**
 
 
• To create 50 million new work opportunities.
 
• To enhance access to higher education.
 
• To provide improved healthcare services.
 
• To ensure environmental sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Inclusive Growth**
 
 
• Inclusive growth focuses on equitable opportunities for all sections of society.
 
• It aims to reduce poverty and inequality.
 
• Inclusive growth ensures that the benefits of economic growth are shared widely.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Growth**
 
 
• Sustainable growth refers to development that meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet their needs.
 
• It emphasizes the sustainable use of natural resources.
 
• Sustainable growth also involves addressing climate change and environmental protection.
